## 📄 YouTube Description
On this episode of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*, I sit down with Bill Tobin — co-founder of **Tribeca Med Spa**, longtime industry leader, and now private equity partner.  

Bill shares his journey of launching one of the most recognized med spas in New York City back in 2006, navigating challenges like the 2008 recession and COVID-19 shutdowns, and ultimately preparing and selling his practice to private equity.  

We cover:  
✨ The early days of med spas and spotting opportunity in a new market  
✨ How Tribeca Med Spa built a reputation for longevity and excellence  
✨ Lessons learned from the first failed PE deal — and how he turned it around  
✨ What practices should do NOW to maximize valuation for a future exit  
✨ Why team culture, transparent metrics, and strong management matter most  
✨ How life changes after a private equity acquisition  

If you’re a med spa owner thinking about scaling, selling, or just sustaining growth in today’s consolidating market, this episode is packed with insights you won’t want to miss.  

🔗 Connect with Bill: bill@tribecamedspot.com  

👉 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and share for more conversations with leaders shaping the future of aesthetics and wellness.
